`COMMON_CELLS_ASSERTS_OFF` is the only configured define; it suppresses assertions but does not affect these declarations or state updates. The dimensions below are packed dimensions.

| Item | Elaboration / arithmetic | Result |
|---|---|---:|
| `lane_t` | `8 + 4 + 1` | **13 bits** |
| `i_dataflow.data_i` | `lane_t [2:0]` = `3 × 13` | **39 bits** |
| One lane FIFO `data_q` | `lane_t [4:0]` = `5 × 13` | **65 bits** |
| One lane FIFO pointers | `$clog2(5) + 1 = 3 + 1` | **4 bits each** |
| All lane-FIFO requested q state | `3 instances × (65 + 4 + 4)` | **219 bits** |
| `i_packet_fifo.fifo_i.mem_q` | `beat_t [4:0]` = `5 × (3 × 13)` | **195 bits** |
| Packet `status_cnt_q`, `usage_o` | `cnt_width(5) = idx_width(6) = $clog2(6)` | **3 bits each** |

`lane_t` is a 13-bit packed struct: payload, tag, and poison are declared in [integration.sv:3](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/idma_state/text-only/rep_2/workspace/integration.sv:3). `beat_t` adds the packed `[2:0]` dimension in [integration.sv:8](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/idma_state/text-only/rep_2/workspace/integration.sv:8), so it is a 39-bit packed aggregate.

The dataflow instance fixes `BufferDepth=5`, `StrbWidth=3`, and `byte_t=lane_t` in [integration.sv:31](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/idma_state/text-only/rep_2/workspace/integration.sv:31). Its `data_i` type is `byte_t [StrbWidth-1:0]` ([idma_dataflow_element.sv:25](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/idma_state/text-only/rep_2/workspace/rtl/src/backend/idma_dataflow_element.sv:25)), hence 39 bits. The generate loop runs for `i=0,1,2` ([idma_dataflow_element.sv:35](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/idma_state/text-only/rep_2/workspace/rtl/src/backend/idma_dataflow_element.sv:35)), creating three lane FIFOs. Each receives `Depth=5` and `data_t=lane_t` ([idma_dataflow_element.sv:36](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/idma_state/text-only/rep_2/workspace/rtl/src/backend/idma_dataflow_element.sv:36)). Its `data_q` is declared as `data_t [Depth-1:0]` and its pointers as `[PointerWidth-1:0]` ([cc_passthrough_stream_fifo.sv:49](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/idma_state/text-only/rep_2/workspace/rtl/.bender/git/checkouts/common_cells-b5ef1d9e9e7e3ce8/src/cc_passthrough_stream_fifo.sv:49), [cc_passthrough_stream_fifo.sv:52](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/idma_state/text-only/rep_2/workspace/rtl/.bender/git/checkouts/common_cells-b5ef1d9e9e7e3ce8/src/cc_passthrough_stream_fifo.sv:52), [cc_passthrough_stream_fifo.sv:56](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/idma_state/text-only/rep_2/workspace/rtl/.bender/git/checkouts/common_cells-b5ef1d9e9e7e3ce8/src/cc_passthrough_stream_fifo.sv:56)).

For the packet FIFO, `i_packet_fifo` supplies `Depth=5`, `FallThrough=1`, and `data_t=beat_t` ([integration.sv:39](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/idma_state/text-only/rep_2/workspace/integration.sv:39)). `cc_stream_fifo.DataWidth` remains its default 32, but its default `data_t = logic [DataWidth-1:0]` is overridden by the explicit 39-bit `beat_t` ([cc_stream_fifo.sv:17](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/idma_state/text-only/rep_2/workspace/rtl/.bender/git/checkouts/common_cells-b5ef1d9e9e7e3ce8/src/cc_stream_fifo.sv:17), [cc_stream_fifo.sv:20](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/idma_state/text-only/rep_2/workspace/rtl/.bender/git/checkouts/common_cells-b5ef1d9e9e7e3ce8/src/cc_stream_fifo.sv:20)). The wrapper forwards `Depth`, `DataWidth=32`, and the actual `data_t=beat_t` to `fifo_i` ([cc_stream_fifo.sv:50](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/idma_state/text-only/rep_2/workspace/rtl/.bender/git/checkouts/common_cells-b5ef1d9e9e7e3ce8/src/cc_stream_fifo.sv:50)). Thus `mem_q` is five 39-bit beats ([cc_fifo.sv:43](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/idma_state/text-only/rep_2/workspace/rtl/.bender/git/checkouts/common_cells-b5ef1d9e9e7e3ce8/src/cc_fifo.sv:43), [cc_fifo.sv:53](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/idma_state/text-only/rep_2/workspace/rtl/.bender/git/checkouts/common_cells-b5ef1d9e9e7e3ce8/src/cc_fifo.sv:53)).

`cc_pkg::idx_width(n)` returns `$clog2(n)` for these values, while `cnt_width(n)` is `idx_width(n+1)` ([cc_pkg.sv:43](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/idma_state/text-only/rep_2/workspace/rtl/.bender/git/checkouts/common_cells-b5ef1d9e9e7e3ce8/src/cc_pkg.sv:43), [cc_pkg.sv:52](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/idma_state/text-only/rep_2/workspace/rtl/.bender/git/checkouts/common_cells-b5ef1d9e9e7e3ce8/src/cc_pkg.sv:52)). Therefore the packet FIFO’s internal pointer width is also 3 (`idx_width(5)`), and `status_cnt_q`/`usage_o` are 3 bits (`cnt_width(5)`).

For item 8: **no**. With only `flush_i` asserted, `mem_q` is not cleared to its reset value at the next rising edge of `clk_i`.

- `flush_i` is ORed with `clr_i` only for the read pointer, write pointer, and status counter ([cc_fifo.sv:120](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/idma_state/text-only/rep_2/workspace/rtl/.bender/git/checkouts/common_cells-b5ef1d9e9e7e3ce8/src/cc_fifo.sv:120)-[cc_fifo.sv:124](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/idma_state/text-only/rep_2/workspace/rtl/.bender/git/checkouts/common_cells-b5ef1d9e9e7e3ce8/src/cc_fifo.sv:124)).
- `mem_q` uses `FFLARNC(..., !gate_clock, clr_i, {FifoDepth{data_t'('0)}}, ...)`: its synchronous clear argument is only `clr_i`, not `clr_i || flush_i` ([cc_fifo.sv:126](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/idma_state/text-only/rep_2/workspace/rtl/.bender/git/checkouts/common_cells-b5ef1d9e9e7e3ce8/src/cc_fifo.sv:126)).
- `FFLARNC` resets asynchronously on `negedge rst_ni`; otherwise, at `posedge clk_i`, it clears on high `clr_i`, then loads only if its load enable is high ([registers.svh:190](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/idma_state/text-only/rep_2/workspace/rtl/.bender/git/checkouts/common_cells-b5ef1d9e9e7e3ce8/include/common_cells/registers.svh:190)). Thus `clear_packet_i` clears packet memory synchronously, while `flush_packet_i` clears logical FIFO state but leaves memory unchanged unless an independent write-enable update occurs.
